title: Book Two · Chapter 178: Their Two Names
story:
The results appear on Monday morning. Leo and Mei have the two full places in the reading materials group.

Ronan sees Leo's name first. For a second, he wishes his name came before Leo's. Then he sees Mei's name below it and thinks of her large, clear words on the notice.

They both did the final tasks. They both earned their places.

The third candidate stands near the door. Miss Wu is speaking with her quietly. The girl's face is still. She takes her paper, says thank you, and walks away with a friend.

Ronan is not the only person who wanted a place. The girl wanted one too.

Leo comes around the corner and stops at the results. He reads the two names. He says nothing at first. Then he looks toward Ronan.

“You got it,” Ronan says.

Leo nods. His smile starts slowly, then fills his face.

“I got it.”

Ronan holds out his hand. Leo takes it and gives it one hard shake.

“You can let go now,” Ronan says. “I need that hand.”

Leo laughs and lets go. He asks if Ronan wants to get food after lessons.

“Not today,” Ronan says. “Another day.”

Leo's face changes a little, but he nods. “All right.”

Mei reaches the wall with Jun. She reads her name, covers her mouth with one hand, then reads it again.

Jun puts his own bag down so she can use the low wall as a seat. She does not sit. She keeps looking at the paper.

Ronan goes over.

“Your times were clear from the paving stone,” he says.

Mei turns. “Thank you for the test.”

“It was your page.”

“Yes,” she says, and smiles.

Miss Wu brings Leo and Mei inside. They need to plan their first group work. Jun goes to his next lesson. Ronan stays in the yard until the door closes.

He wants to kick a stone. He finds one beside his shoe and pushes it into the edge of the path instead.

At home, he tells Mum the two names. She asks if he wants to talk about them.

“Not yet.”

“There is food when you do.”

He goes to his room and takes the six practice pages from his folder. He puts them in a drawer. He will keep them. But he does not want to look at them all afternoon.

Then he opens a storybook at the last place he read. He reaches the end of one page before he thinks of the results again. He turns to the next and tries to stay with the story.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

earn＝凭实际表现获得；shake＝握、摇动；drawer＝抽屉；not yet＝还没有。

## 理解问题

1. Leo和Mei的席位来自什么实际过程？
2. Ronan怎样同时表达祝贺和自己暂时的难受？

## 读句子

**He puts them in a drawer.**

拆开看：He / puts / them in a drawer.

他／把它们／放进抽屉。
